unresolvedConflicts.subject: Patrizia manager-manifest status
unresolvedConflicts.issue: The repository snapshot sets knownManager to false, canonicalManager to null, and contains no fund records, while the separately supplied manager universe includes Patrizia. The scope contract requires the repository snapshot's unknown-manager gate to control the census, so no fund vehicles may be included or proposed.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: A human repository-governance review should reconcile the Patrizia entry in the supplied manager universe with the version-controlled manifest. After Patrizia is established as a known canonical manager, rerun the fund-level census against a refreshed repository snapshot.

notes: The supplied repository snapshot marks Patrizia as knownManager=false and provides no repository fund rows.
